summary: Replaced greedy booking with exact global assignment, directed consecutive-person setup handling, dependency and occupancy checks, timezone fold/gap resolution, and deterministic ASCII tie-breaking without input mutation or calendar access.
tests_run: Provided tests runner: 8 tests passed, 0 failed (2 public and 6 candidate).

Candidate suite includes 100 seeded five-meeting instances compared with an independent exhaustive oracle, plus targeted global optimization, transition, dependency, block, timezone, tie-break, and preservation cases.
limitations: Uses Node Intl timezone data for the specified supported zones and years.
Exact search has exponential worst-case complexity and targets the supplied ten-meeting bound.
Assumes well-formed contract inputs; does not provide live calendar integration.
